# Apollo AA 1.0.1

This release adds more ways to customize the app drawer and multimedia preview.

## What's new

- Set a photo or animated GIF as the app drawer background, with GIF playback speed
  adjustable from 0.5x to 2x.
- Choose ready-made White or Black themes paired with eight accent colors, or the
  Apollo Black & Purple theme. These themes affect only the multimedia preview,
  not the phone app.
- Choose Transparent Border, Round, or Square app tiles alongside Tactile, Keycap, and Flat.
- Pick named colors for the app drawer shapes. Tactile, Keycap, and Flat use solid colors.

Download `Apollo-AA-1.0.1.apk` below. This release is signed for production; future updates
must use the same signing key.

> **If you installed an earlier debug build:** Android treats its debug signing key as a
> different app identity. Uninstall that build before installing this release; uninstalling
> removes the app's local data and settings.
